# zerops_project_l7_balancer_config (Resource)

Authoritatively owns every L7 balancer override for a project. Do not share ownership with another resource or operator. Delete resets all overrides to server defaults.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# This singleton owns ALL balancer overrides; omitted keys reset to defaults.
resource "zerops_project_l7_balancer_config" "example" {
  project_id = zerops_project.example.id
  values = {
    client_max_body_size = "64m"
    keepalive_timeout    = "35"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `project_id` (String)
- `values` (Map of String) Complete authoritative override map. Omitted keys reset to defaults; keys and values must be nonempty.

### Optional

- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) Operation timeouts. One timeout covers lock acquisition, API requests, queued work and readiness polling. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `defaults` (Map of String) Live server defaults, not configured overrides.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours). Setting a timeout for a Delete operation is only applicable if changes are saved into state before the destroy operation occurs.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
#!/bin/sh
terraform import zerops_project_l7_balancer_config.example 'PROJECT_ID'
```
